upgrades.notes:
Bring this site onto the current Landlight template **without changing how it looks or what it says**. Work in a copy, never in production.

0. A copy reopens from its branch and builds it first, and the copy's tools only start once that build passes. Until `npm run build` succeeds, commit on a branch named `$RQEIM_WORK_BRANCH-upgrade` and push there; push the work branch only when the build passes.
1. Fetch the template: `git remote add template https://github.com/RqeimCloud/landlight.js.git && git fetch template main`.
2. Take these from `template/main` as they are: `scripts/`, `vite.config.js`, `Dockerfile`, `nginx.conf`, `.gitignore`, `.dockerignore`, `src/app.js`, `src/alpine.js`, `src/webmcp.js`, `prompts/`, `.agent/`, `AGENTS.md`. Then merge `package.json`: keep the site's own extra dependencies, take the template's scripts and dependencies, and run `npm install` to rewrite `package-lock.json`. The lock must not contain `git+ssh`.
3. Move every page to `src/views/<path>.html`. `src/pages/` is now generated and git-ignored: delete the old copy from git. A site in one language may keep its text in the views. A site in two or more languages has one view per page, its words in `src/locales/<locale>.json` with `{{t:key}}`, and one copy of each component using the same tokens. Read `.agent/PAGES.md` first. Text that JavaScript writes (`data-i18n`, `x-text` from a store, a list built by `x-for`) becomes static HTML with tokens; a language button becomes a link to `{{locale:<code>}}`; every page needs `<main id="main">`, a skip link to `#main`, and a `404` view. Remove scripts that read or store the language.
4. Merge `site.config.json` with the template's: keep every value of this site, add the new fields (`locales` with each language's `og`, name and description, and `exceptions: {}`). Its `url`, `email`, names and colours are this site's, never the template's.
5. Images and fonts: put the originals and the logo (`media/logo.svg`) in `media/`, run `npm run assets`, and use the WebP files it writes; without a logo the icons stay Landlight's. Fonts from Google move to `src/public/fonts/` (see `prompts/02-design.md`). Keep the same pictures and faces.
6. Run `npm run verify` until it ends in `VERIFY PASSED`. Lighthouse 90 in every category is the aim, not a gate: fix what it lists with `prompts/04-verify.md`, and name any score still under 90 in your report. The gate does need what only the owner knows: privacy and terms pages linked from the footer, and a real address for every `href="#"`. Ask for each one that is missing, and for a real email and phone if `site.config.json` has none. A meta description under 120 characters may be lengthened without changing its meaning.
7. Compare the copy's preview with production at 375px and 1440px, page by page and language by language: same layout, same text, same links. Only then, with the owner's permission, publish it and record version 1.

Zero-downtime deploys need a health check. In `Dockerfile`, right after `EXPOSE 80`, add the template's two lines:

```
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1/ || exit 1
```

If this site changed its nginx `listen` port, use that port. Check the copy builds and its preview answers, then publish with the owner's permission and record version 2.

description.ar: موقع سريع بأفضل الممارسات: وصولية عالية، وتحسين لمحركات البحث، وصفحات يفهمها وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي، بلغة واحدة أو أكثر. للمواقع التعريفية وصفحات الهبوط والمحتوى، بلا قاعدة بيانات.
description.en: A fast website built on best practice: high accessibility, search engine optimisation and pages AI agents can read, in one language or more. For company sites, landing pages and content, with no database.
